description: This file defines a mock class 'GstProtectionMetadataWrapperMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper' interface. It uses Google Mock to mock methods related to handling protection metadata in GStreamer buffers within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper' interface, used for unit testing protection metadata handling in GStreamer buffers.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Mocks the method to add protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve protection metadata data from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Mocks the method to remove protection metadata from a GstBuffer.
